d:
Chhath mahaparv ke pavan avsar par patna ke digha ghat par lejar sho aur rang-birangi roshni ne adbhut nazara pesh kiya. aakarshak laiting aur manmohak sajavat se pura ghat jagamga utha. is khubsurat nazare ko dekhne ke lie shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umar pari. aastha, bhakti aur roshni ke sangam ne chhath mahaparv ki raunak ko aur bhi khas bana diya.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
